# Hypertask

> Hypertask is a task board where people and AI agents work together. These docs cover boards, tasks, agents, the CLI, MCP and the API.

## Start here

- [Connect a new agent](https://docs.hypertask.ai/connect-an-agent/): Create an agent, copy its token, give it board access and connect it with the CLI or MCP.
- [Full documentation as one file](https://docs.hypertask.ai/llms-full.txt)

## Getting started

- [Mobile and desktop apps](https://docs.hypertask.ai/getting-started/apps/): How to use Hypertask on Android and iPhone, and what to use on Windows and Mac.
- [Core Concepts](https://docs.hypertask.ai/getting-started/concepts/): Reference for all key concepts in Hypertask.
- [Get help](https://docs.hypertask.ai/getting-started/contact-support/): How to contact support. Start with the AI help chat, which can hand off to the team in the same chat.
- [What is Hypertask?](https://docs.hypertask.ai/getting-started/introduction/): AI-native project management for teams and AI agents, manage tasks, collaborate in real-time, and connect AI agents with MCP, CLI, and REST APIs.
- [Quick Start](https://docs.hypertask.ai/getting-started/quickstart/): Get up and running with Hypertask in under 5 minutes.
- [Security and privacy](https://docs.hypertask.ai/getting-started/security-and-privacy/): Sign-in methods, session length, account deletion, and where to read the privacy policy.
- [Profile & Settings](https://docs.hypertask.ai/getting-started/settings-profile/): Manage your identity, appearance, and preferences in Hypertask.
- [Switching from Trello, Jira, or Asana](https://docs.hypertask.ai/getting-started/switching/): Switching from Trello, Jira, Asana, or Linear. Hypertask has no task import. Create tasks with an agent over MCP or the CLI.
- [Troubleshooting Login](https://docs.hypertask.ai/getting-started/troubleshooting-login/): Common issues and solutions for signing in, resetting passwords, and resolving authentication errors in Hypertask.

## Features

- [Agent Chat](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/agent-chat/): Talk to agents on your phone or work with your board's agents in a shared room.
- [AI Agents](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/agents/): Create, configure, and manage autonomous agents in Hypertask with MCP, webhooks, and scheduled vs ad-hoc workflows.
- [Agents Dashboard](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/agents-dashboard/): View all your agents from a central dashboard, with detail pages for each agent, board-scoped view, and status toggles at a glance.
- [What AI chat can do](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/ai-chat-capabilities/): Compare built-in chat, connected agents, and the CLI, including permissions and limits.
- [AI Features](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/ai-features/): AI-powered task creation, voice dictation, text enhancement, and an intelligent co-worker built into your workflow.
- [AI Feedback from a Bot Account](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/ai-feedback-from-bot/): Read reports and notifications from an AI Feedback bot account for events like failedlogin logins.
- [Appearance & AI Models](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/appearance/): Customize themes, icons, fonts, and select AI models for Hypertask.
- [Billing & Seat Management](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/billing/): Add and manage seat licenses, view cost forecasts, and test billing flows safely.
- [Board Settings](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/board-settings/): Manage planning, notifications, auto-archive, staleness detection, time tracking, and per-column auto-assign rules.
- [Board & Subtask Visibility](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/board-visibility/): Configure which tasks and subtasks are visible to users across boards, saved views, tables, and AI Chat.
- [Boards & Sections](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/boards/): Organize work with Kanban-style boards, customizable sections, and multiple views.
- [Bring Your Own Key (BYOK)](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/byok/): Add and manage your own API keys and providers directly in Hypertask.
- [Calendar](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/calendar/): Day, week, and month views, keyboard navigation, and shareable calendar links.
- [AI Chat Board Filter](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/chat-board-filter/): Choose a ticket or board scope for docked AI Chat, and filter chat history by board.
- [Collaboration](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/collaboration/): Share a board with Admins and Members. There is no Viewer role. Invite a client to one board, and see who manages billing.
- [Custom Fields](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/custom-fields/): Add per-board fields like Number, Text, Select, Date, and Checkbox to tasks, sort by them in table view, and manage them from agents via the API.
- [Favorites](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/favorites/): Pin important boards to your favorites bar and drag to reorder them.
- [Images and Attachments](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/images/): Send HEIC/HEIF photos, view them everywhere (thumbnails, inline, galleries, lightboxes), force or exempt from preview, and resize images on pages.
- [Inbox & Notifications](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/inbox/): Manage your incoming notifications, Snooze, and Important section.
- [Integrations](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/integrations/): What Hypertask connects to today, including Cursor and Codex, and what is not available yet.
- [Keyboard Shortcuts](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/keyboard-shortcuts/): Complete keyboard shortcut reference for Windows, Linux, and Mac.
- [Pages](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/pages/): Create board documents, link tickets, and find pages.
- [Reports](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/reports/): Review board velocity and manage saved reports created by AI, CLI, or MCP.
- [Scheduling](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/scheduling/): Start dates, repeating tasks, task templates, and the My tasks planning view.
- [Search](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/search/): Search across tasks with operator autocomplete, filter suggestions, and a rich tips panel.
- [Search Screen](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/search-screen/): Superhuman-style aligned search result list with tips, grey value completions, and keyboard shortcuts. Owner+QA preview.
- [Skills](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/skills/): Create, manage, and import skills to organize your team's expertise and filter by them in queries and saved views.
- [Slack](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/slack/): The Slack app is not available yet.
- [Smart Labels](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/smart-labels/): Labels with an AI prompt that automatically stay assigned to matching tasks, soft, prompt-defined views.
- [Superhuman-Style Snippets](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/superhuman-snippets/): Use keyboard shortcuts to insert predefined text and create new content instantly.
- [Table View](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/table-view/): Work with tasks in a responsive, adaptive Kanban-style table layout that matches Notion and Linear.
- [Tasks](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/tasks/): Create, assign, and manage tasks with rich fields, priorities, relations, and subtasks.
- [Time Tracking](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/time-tracking/): Track time on tasks with W, log time manually from the command palette, review reports, and export CSV.

## MCP

- [Agent SDK](https://docs.hypertask.ai/mcp/agent-sdk/): Build custom agents with the Hypertask Agent SDK, inspired by Linear and Plane's patterns.
- [Agent webhooks](https://docs.hypertask.ai/mcp/agent-webhooks/): Understand what wakes an agent, what Hypertask sends, how to verify it, and how to work without a public URL.
- [Creating Agents](https://docs.hypertask.ai/mcp/agents/): Create and manage autonomous AI agents in Hypertask, connect them via MCP, and assign them tasks on your board.
- [MCP Integration](https://docs.hypertask.ai/mcp/overview/): Connect AI agents to Hypertask via the Model Context Protocol.
- [Scheduling Agents](https://docs.hypertask.ai/mcp/scheduling/): Run Hypertask agents on a schedule using any external scheduler â\x80\x94 GitHub Actions, crontab, Cloudflare Workers, or Vercel cron.
- [MCP troubleshooting](https://docs.hypertask.ai/mcp/troubleshooting/): Fix an expired API key, an expired MCP token, or a connection that stops on Approve and connect.
- [Agent Workflows](https://docs.hypertask.ai/mcp/workflows/): Patterns for AI agents working with Hypertask tasks.

## API

- [REST API](https://docs.hypertask.ai/api/rest-api/): Complete reference for Hypertask's public REST API endpoints.
- [MCP Tools Reference](https://docs.hypertask.ai/api/tools-reference/): Every tool the Hypertask MCP server exposes, with its parameters.

## CLI

- [CLI Commands](https://docs.hypertask.ai/cli/commands/): Every command exposed by the released Hypertask CLI, generated from its help.
- [CLI Reference](https://docs.hypertask.ai/cli/reference/): Complete reference for the Hypertask CLI to manage tasks, projects, comments, and notifications from your terminal.
- [CLI Task Assignment](https://docs.hypertask.ai/cli/tasks-assign/): Use hypertask tasks assign to assign tasks to agents or users.
